values.subject: Withholding correction case accepted: April performance and departure settlement pending review
values.body_text:
We opened withholding correction case TAX-CORR-2026-0618 using the bank-credit dates and payroll references you supplied.
This confirms acceptance only; the correction is not completed. We will send the before-and-after variance after the tax-system receipt arrives. Do not record accepted as corrected.
